products.title: 12V 2kW Diesel Heater
products.body_html:
You'll never have to avoid camping during the cold winter months with this quiet and efficient Aussie Traveller diesel powered heater. This compact designed 12V 2kW heater has excellent fuel efficiency and power consumption. You won’t even notice that this whisper quiet heater is running in your caravan or RV, so you can enjoy the warmth while your chatting away, listening to music or watching TV.

Equipped with Automatic Altitude Adjustment, it has a working height all the way up to 5000m above sea level. The heater is essentially a small fuel furnace controlled by a single-chip microprocessor. Its furnace body (the heat exchanger) is located in the hood shaped case, which serves as an independent air passage. Cold air is drawn into the air passage by the fan, heated by the heat exchanger and blown out as hot air.

Featuring an easy-to-read digital display and complete with an installation kit, you can quickly warm up your caravan or RV on those chilly winter days.

The original and the best Aussie Traveller Anti-Flap Kit (AFK) prevents wind flap and provides a waterproof method to attach walls to your awning. The AFK is easy to install and is perfectly designed to suit most brands of roll-out awnings and walls. 

Featuring the in-built smart 6mm sail track design, the AFK allows you to easily install walls, annexes and accessories, giving you more time to enjoy your holiday.

Please select the Anti-Flap Kit size required by clicking on the drop down box above

Refer to the Specifications below for sizing, measurement details and components required for cassette/wind-out awnings.

Features
  • Available in three sizes in white or black
  • Quick and easy to set up
  • Protects the awning from wind-flap
    Innovative smart design features sail tracks to easily attach walls, annexes and
    other accessories
  • Additional external sail track
  • Fitting brackets included

For an easy storage solution for your AFK, you can purchase our Anti-Flap Kit Storage Bag here


Specifications

Anti-Flap Kit Sizing:

  • 2100 - 2200mm
  • 2200 - 2300mm
  • 2300 - 2400mm

*Extension brackets are available for awnings with projections greater than 2400mm.

The Anti-Flap Kit breaks down to 4 individual sections (2 pieces per end), when joined together form a full-length clamp. This full-length clamp holds to the awning fabrics outside edge to prevent wind flap.

Measure the awning extension from the wall of the vehicle to the roller tube, to determine the correct Anti Flap Kit length required. Please refer to the diagram below.
Reminder to ensure awning is fully rolled out and open as normal.

Adding AFK's to Cassette awnings is possible by using either a 100mm extension for awning projection up to 2.60m or a 300mm extension for projections up to 3.00m.

products.title: Coolabah Awning
products.body_html:
Manufactured and assembled in Australia, the Coolabah Awning is arguably the strongest and quietest awning, most suited for pop-top caravans, caravans, wind-up campers, camper trailers and buses. This waterproof awning is quick and easy to set up, with the option to add in walls using the zip-on wall system.

Please see Specifications below for more product details and custom ordering information.

Features:
  • Fabric available in Grey, Tan or Silver-Grey
  • Hardware available in White or Black
  • Built-in cross wire bracing system providing stability against the wind
  • Zip-on wall system for easy installation of walls
  • Fold up system for easy set up and pack down
  • Mounting brackets included
  • Available in custom sizing
Specifications

Awning Projection

Standard awning projection is 8'

We recommend a 7' custom projection for all awnings that are to be mounted at a height of less than 2130mm from the ground.

Awning Size

The awning size is measured by the length of the roof as the cassette is 165mm longer than the roof.

Mounting Brackets

We have 3 types of brackets available:

  • Pop-Top – For Pop-top Caravans
  • Angle up/down – For top of the vehicle
  • Sail Track – For mounting to side of vehicle

Ordering Information

Please note, as this product is made to order, dispatch time will be slightly longer than usual. You will be contacted with an estimated arrival after placing your order. 

Should you require any of the below, please contact us and we will be able to assist with finalising your order

  • Require 7’ awning projection
  • Unsure of what size would be suitable for your vehicle
  • Require custom sizing

products.title: Curved Roof Rafter - 3-Piece
products.body_html:
Make the most of your outdoor escape with an awning that stays tight, dry and protected, thanks to the Xtend 3-Piece Curved Roof Rafter.

Engineered to the perfect shape to allow efficient water run-off while keeping awnings safe and damage-free, the Xtend Curved Roof Rafter is built to eliminate wind flap and prevent sagging. It’s the perfect companion to the Aussie Traveller Anti-Flap Kit!

Its unique 3-piece construction makes installation simple and allows for compact storage when not in use, perfect for caravanners on the move. The 95–98mm curve gives your awning the support it needs without the strain on the fabric.

Whether you're pairing it with our Anti-Flap Kit or using it on its own, the Xtend Curved Roof Rafter is the ideal upgrade for any awning setup. Available in classic Black or White, it's compatible with most rollout and cassette awnings up to 2.5m projection.

Features:
  • Easy to install and remove
  • Adjustable 3-piece design for compact storage
  • Promotes water run-off and prevents pooling
  • Keeps awning fabric tight and reduces wind flap
  • Minimises fabric stretching or marking
  • Available in White and Black
  • Fitting brackets included
  • Suits most rollout and cassette awnings (up to 2.5m projection)
